csap_ctrl_global_offset_table_got_and_po.topic: Global Offset Table (GOT) and Position-Independent Code (PIC)
csap_ctrl_global_offset_table_got_and_po.code:
.global my_pic_func
.type my_pic_func, @function

my_pic_func:
# Access external symbol 'target_var' via GOT/PIC

# 1. Calculate address of target_var's entry in the GOT
#    (Using PC-relative addressing: RIP + offset)
    movq    target_var@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax

# 2. Load the absolute address (resolved by dynamic loader)
#    from the Global Offset Table entry pointed to by RAX
    movq    (%rax), %rbx

# 3. Access the data using the resolved absolute address
    movl    (%rbx), %ecx

    ret
.size my_pic_func, .-my_pic_func

csap_op_conditional_moves_and_processor_.code:
; CONDITIONAL MOVES (CMOV) - Avoiding Pipeline Stalls

; Traditional Branch (High Latency Risk)
    cmp r10, r11
    jg .L_Target         ; Branch: Flushes pipeline on mispredict
    mov r12, r13
.L_Target:

; Conditional Move (Pipelining Friendly)
    mov r12, 0           ; Setup default
    cmp r10, r11
    cmovg r12, r13       ; Move r13 -> r12 only IF Greater
                         ; No control flow change
                         ; Allows continuous instruction flow
                         ; Reduces penalty of unknown conditions
